Starting in MongoDB 5.0, the [plan cache](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/manual/core/query-plans.md#std-label-query-plans-query-optimization) will save full `plan cache` entries only if the cumulative size of the `plan caches` for all collections is lower than 0.5 GB. When the cumulative size of the `plan caches` for all collections exceeds this threshold, additional `plan cache` entries are stored without the following debug information:
- A percentage of the system's total physical memory to allocate for the plan cache. For example, `"8.5%"`.
- The exact amount of data to allocate for the plan cache in either `MB` or `GB`. For example, `"100MB"` or `"1GB"`.

Since 6.3 the planCacheSize parameter sets the cache size, with a default of 5% of memory (per Percona).

A replanning loop occurs when data changes faster than the planner adapts. Causes: data-dependent filter values, non-selective indexes, near-tied plans, rapid cardinality change (bulk insert/delete, TTL, capped overwrite), and $or/$in/$regex with variable item counts. Diagnose with slow-log fields replanned: true, replanReason, planningTimeMicros, fromMultiPlanner, queryHash and planCacheKey.

Active: used to generate plans. A newly selected plan whose work value is less than or equal to the placeholder's replaces it and becomes Active. If the value is greater, the placeholder stays and its value is incremented. An Active entry whose work no longer meets the selection criterion drops to Inactive.
